CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid Community Applications templates maintained by SEC844. This repository currently ships Analysarr, a self-hosted dashboard that brings together Emby or Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr and your torrent client (qBittorrent, Deluge or Transmission) to show the health of every movie and series across the stack: duplicates, orphan torrents, broken hardlinks, single-tracker content and episodes never imported by the media server. Support questions, bug reports and feature requests are welcome on the Unraid forum support thread or on GitHub.
